decisions.statement: A row carries the moment, the sender, and the text.
A named group chat carries its display name before the sender.
Unread counts only messages carried to Alan's own number within thirty days.
Saying no limit answers every unread message rather than a capped list.
A handle no contact names is answered as the handle itself.
The messages are answered oldest first.
Nothing here marks a message read.

definition: the command giving back the unread messages that came to Alan
